lens-performance-code finding 1: wrong — `resume_mode` not being cleared mid-loop is a known non-blocking trade-off; subsequent stages after the interrupted one cannot be `complete` in a correctly-interrupted run, so the guard short-circuits after one successful jq lookup (empty status → not `complete` → no skip); this is a performance observation, not a correctness gap in any stated requirement.
